description: infiniFi Data: read-only infiniFi protocol data for agents, passed through from the infiniFi API (api.infinifi.xyz). Every endpoint is a POST with a JSON body. Protocol: /v1/overview (TVL, liquid/illiquid split, iUSD/siUSD supply and rates), /v1/yields (siUSD and liUSD 1-13 week tier APYs), /v1/farms and /v1/farm (where USDC is deployed, APY, assets, maturity), /v1/params, /v1/redemption-queue, /v1/redemption-quote, /v1/allocation-votes, /v1/opportunities (partner yields with infiniFi's own links). Wallet, by address: /v1/wallet summary, /v1/wallet/pnl, /history (7/30/90/365 days or all), /unwinding, /redemptions, /votes, /points. APYs are fractions; amounts are whole tokens. Every response is a JSON object with fetched_at and stale. Never signs or prepares a transaction. Not affiliated with infiniFi. Endpoint list: GET /v1/capabilities.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/<endpoint> with a JSON body (endpoints without required input also answer GET), plus GET /v1/version, /healthz, /v1/capabilities, /v1/openapi.json. Every response is a JSON object, including errors (which carry an 'error' field).

specs.notes: The same document is served by the backend at GET /v1/openapi.json.

serving.backend: The infinifi container (Node 22, no third-party dependencies; built from github.com/TheFeloniousMonk/portal-services, infinifi/backend) behind the HA RelayMiner with the rest backend pointed at it. A stateless pass-through: each relay makes one to five GETs to the public infiniFi API, which needs no key. Protocol-wide reads are cached in memory for 60 s (votes and opportunities 300 s) and served stale for up to 15 minutes if the upstream is down; wallet reads are never cached. Needs outbound HTTPS to api.infinifi.xyz. Light on CPU and RAM. Tunable with IF_* environment variables.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service so a wrong backend cannot be staked under this id.
Readiness probe: 200 only while the infiniFi protocol data can be served, fresh or from the 15-minute stale window.
Functional probe: the staked token is always siUSD, so the check is stable while the APYs change. Served from the shared 60 s cache.

serving.notes: Answers in well under a second when cached and within the 8 s upstream deadline otherwise. No rate limits to disable. Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"] and a relay_timeout of at least 15s; see sage-service.yaml in the service repository.
